title: 1.Resuscitation of bacterial community for enhanced phenol degradation under high salinity conditions
description: 2.In this study, the bacterial composition of thesludge sample from industrial wastewater treatment was investigated. Then Rpf from Micrococcus luteus was used to enhance phenol biodegradation. The effect of the Rpf on the composition of bacterial community was investigated.
